reviews.text: I can’t say enough good things about our experience with the pool cleaning and renovation team. From day one, Mike made sure the job was only what we needed—no pushy sales or trying to get us to pay for things we didn’t want. He started by drawing up a full plan for our pool renovation and spa addition, and even provided a 3-D rendering so we could really see what our backyard would look like before any work started. Mike handled everything, from the technical drawings and permits to answering every question we had along the way. We even got bids from other companies, and Mike encouraged us to do so, showing how confident he was in his work. In the end, we felt his price was fair and the quality matched what we expected. Once work started, Mike’s crew was always on time, professional, and kept the work area as tidy as possible, which we really appreciated—especially with all the Texas sun and dust. They finished everything on our checklist quickly, and even went the extra mile by power washing the driveway so the whole area was spotless when they left. The pool and spa look amazing now, and you’d never guess any of the changes were added later. The crew was responsive, and Mike was always just a phone call away. We’re so happy with the results, and with how clean and smooth the whole process was. Thanks to their great work, our pool should stay in top shape for a long time! If you need pool cleaning, renovation, or spa work, I highly recommend this team.
reviews.author: Madeline5 B

reviews.text: Choice Coppell Pool Cleaners took care of our pool in Flower Mound, making sure it was always sparkling and ready to enjoy, especially during the hot Texas days. When we had a leak recently, Ardie quickly found and fixed the problem. The team did a great job and worked professionally the whole time. Everyone we met was friendly, efficient, and worked hard to get our pool back in perfect shape. We’re really happy with the service and highly recommend them to anyone needing reliable pool cleaning and repair.
reviews.author: Olivia Mcgrath

reviews.text: Choice Coppell Pool Cleaners is truly the best when it comes to pool cleaning and service. This company is locally owned and always delivers outstanding customer care. Every step of the pool cleaning process was handled smoothly, and the crew made sure everything was spotless after each visit. I’ve already recommended them to many friends and neighbors, and everyone has been very satisfied with the sparkling results. I am happy to support such a reliable pool cleaning service and stand by their work.
reviews.author: Kathy Cummings

reviews.text: After having our pool built in Flower Mound with a pebble finish, we started seeing some strange streaks and white spots show up way too soon. instead of getting help from the pool builder, we kept getting bounced around with no real answers. We did a lot of research and finally found Choice Coppell Pool Cleaners for ongoing pool cleaning and maintenance. blake responded to our questions super fast and even came out to check our pool the next day. He brought different pool surface samples so we could see how they looked underwater and helped us pick the right color. Even though we had to wait a little while for the supplies, blake went the extra mile and tracked down everything we needed right here in Texas. When the job started, the team worked quickly and handled everything carefully, making sure not to mess up our patio. The crew was professional, and they even polished the pool by hand when they finished. Now, our pool always looks sparkling clean, and the water is crystal clear. The finish feels nice on your feet, and the color really pops in the Texas sunlight. We are so happy with our pool now—it looks better than ever, and we love how easy it is to keep clean. If you need pool cleaning or want to keep your pool looking great, this is the best company to call in Flower Mound!
reviews.author: Andrew O

reviews.text: I really appreciate their pool cleaning services. Every time, my pool looks sparkling clean, just like it did when we first got it installed. I highly recommend their team. Eric is always friendly and makes sure to leave extra pool chemicals for me to use if I need them before the next visit.
reviews.author: howard roach

reviews.text: We recently moved to Flower Mound and needed help finding a reliable pool cleaning company, since we didn’t know anyone in the area. The builder gave us a few recommendations for pool services. Even though one company gave us a lower price, we decided to go with this team because we care a lot about quality and good service. At our first meeting, chris dropped by and shared a lot of helpful advice about keeping our pool clean and clear, which made us feel like valued customers. Before the work began, chris called to thank us for choosing them and shared additional tips about taking care of pools in the Flower Mound heat. He even recommended a great company for outdoor kitchens, which we ended up using. austin visited our home before they started the pool cleaning service to explain the process and what we could expect. austin has a really friendly and easygoing attitude that made us feel comfortable right away. He also suggested some great upgrades, like a panoramic pool screen, a long bench along the pool, and adding an automatic cleaning system. The whole process was finished right on schedule, and we also met blake and another team member, who were both super nice and helpful. We had a small issue with the auto-fill system, but it was fixed quickly and without any hassle. We were especially impressed that austin took the time to make sure the area was clean after the repair and even brought some small rocks to make a safe, mud-free path for us. That really meant a lot! Overall, we had a wonderful experience with this pool cleaning team. The staff in the office were always friendly and worked with us whenever we had questions. Any small problems were handled with care and attention. We definitely recommend them to anyone needing pool cleaning in Flower Mound!
reviews.author: Caroline Maxwell

reviews.text: i highly recommend Choice Coppell Pool Cleaners because the team really knows their stuff and always helps out. christopher was able to repair my pool heater even after another company said it needed to be replaced. their technicians have the experience to solve pool issues that others can’t. my pool in flower mound is running great now, and i appreciate their excellent service.
reviews.author: Grant15 W

reviews.text: We recently had our pool resurfaced and we're extremely happy with how everything turned out. Chris was our superintendent and did a fantastic job, always checking in on the progress, answering our questions, and keeping us updated about each step of the process and when the crew would arrive. The pool service team was professional, efficient, and clearly knew what they were doing. At the end of each day, they made sure the area was spotless—you couldn’t even tell any work had been done. We’re very pleased with the quality and service we received here in Flower Mound, and would definitely recommend them to anyone looking for reliable pool service.
reviews.author: Barbara Shea

data.summary: The reviews are highly detailed, mention specific employees and projects, and exhibit varied writing styles, strongly indicating authenticity. The lack of any critical reviews in the sample and the clustering of review dates are minor concerns, but the content quality outweighs these signals. No complaint patterns or warranty issues were detected.

All sampled reviews are 5-star, showing no critical feedback
